function.name: calculate_Bond_Price
function.description: Calculate the bond price given the face value, coupon rate, required rate of return, and maturity period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
抱歉，我目前無法即時查詢最新的市場數據。若想知道今天美國的黃金價格，建議您參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 平台 | 特色 | 連結 |
|------|------|------|
| Bloomberg | 提供即時行情、新聞與分析 | https://www.bloomberg.com/markets |
| Kitco | 專門報導貴金屬價格，含實時圖表 | https://www.kitco.com |
| Investing.com | 全球金融市場數據，含黃金即時價格 | https://www.investing.com/commodities/gold |
| 美國商品期貨交易所（CME） | 官方期貨價格與合約資訊 | https://www.cmegroup.com |

在這些網站上，您可以查看「Gold (XAU/USD)」或「黃金」的即時價格、歷史走勢以及相關新聞。若您需要更精確的數字（例如到小數點後兩位），請直接進入上述任一平台的即時行情頁面。
message.reasoning: User asks: "今天美國的黃金價格是多少？" They want today's gold price in US. We need to provide current price. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we don't have real-time data. We can suggest checking reliable sources. We can also provide typical price range. But we should not fabricate. So answer: I don't have real-time data. Suggest checking websites like Bloomberg, Kitco, etc.
